title: Voltage-Fed Push-Pull Resonant Inverter
description: Voltage-fed push-pull resonant inverter (100 kHz) driving a series-resonant tank and transformer. Produces a roughly 68 V-RMS sinusoidal output (about +/-84 V peak) across a 100 ohm load.

source.author: J. Marcos Alonso
source.permission: Adapted and redistributed with the author's permission.
source.note: voltage_fed_push_pull.qsch is Alonso's schematic; voltage_fed_push_pull.cir is the self-contained QUX netlist (his behavioral library inlined), ready to run without external symbol files.

workflows.title: Voltage-Fed Push-Pull Resonant Inverter -- materialize recipe
workflows.summary: Copy the bundled files into the workspace and simulate the self-contained .cir (Track B).
